story.iWant: a searchable dropdown to select my device grouped by chipset
story.soThat: I can easily find my device

tasks.task: Load devices data with useDevices hook
Add UX polish: loading, empty, keyboard nav

acceptanceCriteria.ac: Device selector dropdown displays all devices from devices.json
Devices are visually grouped by chipset family (e.g., SD 8 Gen 3, SD 888)
Search/filter functionality filters devices by name, codename, or chipset
Selected device is displayed with device name and chipset name
Selection is persisted in settingsStore.lastDeviceId and restored on reload
Dropdown has proper UX: loading state, empty state, keyboard navigation

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web Architecture
doc.snippet: All feature components follow this structure: use cn() for className merging, useTranslation hook at top, derive state from stores, memoize handlers with useCallback.

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web Architecture
doc.snippet: Feature components go in src/components/features/{feature}/. Device-related components include DeviceCard.tsx, DeviceSelector.tsx, ConnectionStatus.tsx.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Use shadcn/ui Command or Combobox component. Group devices by chipset in dropdown. Persist lastDeviceId in settingsStore.

doc.snippet: Device entries have: id, brand, name, codename, chipset, chipsetName, status ('tested'|'beta'|'coming'), authMethod, presetId, firehose URLs.

artifact.reason: Primary store for device selection. Has setDevice(), selectedDevice, isConnected states. Component must call setDevice(device) on selection.
Persisted store with lastDeviceId field. Use setLastDeviceId(id) to persist selected device. Auto-restores on page reload via localStorage.
Target location for DeviceSelector integration. Currently has device card placeholder. Insert DeviceSelector before device info section.
shadcn/ui Button component. Use as trigger for popover. Shows selected device or placeholder text.
Device data source. 37+ devices with fields: id, brand, name, codename, chipset, chipsetName, status, authMethod, presetId, firehose URLs.

node.note: More Radix components needed: @radix-ui/react-popover, cmdk for Command component

constraints.constraint: Follow Component Pattern from architecture.md: hooks at top, derived state, memoized handlers with useCallback
Use shadcn/ui Command or Combobox pattern for searchable dropdown
Device selection must sync with both deviceStore (runtime) and settingsStore (persistent)
All user-facing text must use useTranslation() hook and have keys in en.json/vi.json
Use Tailwind CSS classes with cn() utility for className merging
Component file: PascalCase (DeviceSelector.tsx). Export: named function export

tests.standards: Testing framework: Vitest + React Testing Library (to be installed). Component tests should verify rendering, interaction, and store updates. Use mock data for devices.json.

ideas.idea: Test DeviceSelector renders all devices from mock data
Test devices are grouped by chipsetName with correct headers
Test search filters devices correctly (name, codename, chipset)
Test selecting device calls deviceStore.setDevice with correct data
Test lastDeviceId is saved to settingsStore on selection
Test component auto-selects device matching lastDeviceId on mount
Test loading skeleton appears while fetching
Test keyboard navigation (arrow keys, enter, escape)
Test component renders correctly in both EN and VI locales

implementation-notes.note: shadcn/ui Command component needs to be installed: npx shadcn@latest add command popover This will add @radix-ui/react-popover and cmdk packages.
DeviceProfile interface in deviceStore.ts uses chipsetFolder, but devices.json uses chipset. Consider extending DeviceProfile or mapping fields when loading.
useDevices hook should be created to fetch and cache devices.json data. Consider using SWR or simple useState + useEffect pattern.
chipsetName field is ideal for grouping (e.g., "Snapdragon 8 Gen 3"). Sort groups by releasing order (newest first) for better UX.
